title: Leaflets
slide_intent: Show how an attention-getting cover can lead into a readable folded piece. The reader needs a different hierarchy once the leaflet opens.
strategic_value: Frontline AIDS can retain its expressive typography and illustration on a small printed format while giving explanations their own space.
demonstration: An angled arrangement on green shows leaflet fronts with photography or illustration and an opened fold with numbered sections, images and text blocks.
practical_value: Compare the impact of the closed leaflet with the space available for instructions inside. Use the numbered panels to plan the sequence.

content_islands.name: Leaflet covers
content_islands.spec: Set the varied portrait covers at an angle, retaining the separate type-led, image-led and illustrated treatments.

content_islands.name: Opened fold
content_islands.spec: Place the unfolded blue piece prominently among the covers so its numbered reading order and text density can be inspected.
